pages.title: Goggles
pages.text: String, a Netherite Ingot and two Breeze Crystals. Worn on the head.

pages.title: Seeing the scan
pages.text: With the goggles on, a scan draws every block it reported as a coloured box $(thing)through the rock$(), for about twelve seconds.$(br2)They show nothing on their own. This is not x-ray vision: it draws only what the detector already told you, and only what the liquid actually paid for.

pages.title: Strain
pages.text: Each visualisation adds $(thing)20 strain$(), which bleeds off on its own. Cross $(thing)100$() and the goggles give you $(thing)Nausea$() and refuse to draw until they recover.$(br2)Hover them to see the number. The detector itself is never blocked, so the counts keep coming even when the picture will not.$(br2)Goggles wear by 1 per ore block reported while worn, and take Breeze Shards like the detector.
